about: Known exceptions to the open-engine rule (see docs/environment-authoring.md). This list may only shrink; scripts/open-engine.test.mjs fails if code adds an exception or fixes one without updating this file.

world/scripts/world.gd.reason: The Grid is the start zone and shares the workshop's WorldTools.

world/scripts/world_art.gd.reason: Gradient sky falls back to the Grid's colours; one match is the construct effect shader, not the package.

world/scripts/rendering/zone_effects.gd.reason: Matches the construct effect shader by its code, not the Grid package.

world/scripts/workshop/scene_placement.g.reason: Named bounds for the three original packages, used by tool validation and tests.

gateway/workbench-diagnostics.mjs.reason: The benchmark_villa tool reads villa samples.

gateway/workbench-runner.mjs.reason: The benchmark_villa tool runs the villa benchmark.

code_builders.construct: Grid floor and walls become piece types (roadmap step 2).
code_builders.villa: Villa becomes a document once water, planting and materials are pieces (roadmap step 6).
code_builders.beach: Shore becomes a document once terrain and water are pieces (roadmap step 6).
